## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy characterized primarily by his prominent, goggle-like eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbours political ambitions, aiming to eventually become a member of Parliament. He has also long been infatuated with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was known to have been infatuated with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when they were seventeen. He attended a farewell party thrown by the A. V. I. S. for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before traveling with them by train and boat to college in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P38](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0038), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), +11 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who travel together to college at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Though they share a close acquaintance and participate in the same social circles, Charlie considers [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) a rival for the affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), +7 more_

- presumed Rival of — rivals in the good graces of a certain damsel with gray eyes (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
